name: Settings & shortcuts
tagline: Themes, GitHub access and the shortcut list
summary: Personal settings: light, dark or system mode, a colour theme for each mode, links to manage GitHub access and organisations, the extension's status, sign out, and a shortcut reference.

flow.label: Settings layout
flow.note: /settings shows a side nav (General, Shortcuts) and the selected page.

flow.label: General page
flow.note: Sections for appearance, extension, repository access, organisations and account.

flow.label: Colour theme store
flow.note: setColorTheme saves the id and sets data-light-theme or data-dark-theme on <html>.

flow.label: localStorage
flow.note: Keys diffkit:color-theme:light and :dark; a change in one tab updates the others.

flow.label: Head boot script
flow.note: An inline script in <head> re-applies the saved theme ids before the first paint.

flow.label: Theme stylesheet
flow.note: Rules keyed on those attributes change the neutral colour scale for each theme.

features.name: Light, dark, system
features.summary: A mode picker with miniature layout previews. The same three-way switch also sits in the account menu.

entry.role: Mode picker on the General page
Compact switch in the account menu

features.name: Colour theme per mode
features.summary: Five palettes (DiffKit, Tide, Graphite, Paper, Linear), chosen separately for light and dark and saved on this device.

entry.role: The theme list and preview swatches
Saves and applies a theme for one mode
Radio cards, one group per mode

features.name: No-flash theme boot
features.summary: A tiny script in the document head copies the saved theme ids onto <html> before first paint and ignores unknown ids.

entry.role: The inline script as a string
Root route that injects the script

features.name: Access, orgs and account
features.summary: Links to /setup for GitHub App access and to each organisation's settings, the extension's install state, and sign out.

entry.role: All sections of the General page
List of your organisations with links
Shows whether the extension is installed

features.name: Shortcut reference
features.summary: A static page listing shortcuts by group: navigation, workspace, list selection, general and the markdown editor.

entry.role: The hand-written list the page renders

features.name: Shortcut engine
features.summary: One hook matches single keys and sequences such as G then P (800 ms between keys) and skips typing in inputs unless a shortcut allows it.

entry.role: Compares one key event to one step
Registers O R, G U and the N-key create keys

entryPoints.role: Theme list, storage, boot script and hook in one file
The shortcut hook every feature uses
Example of a feature registering its keys

goodParts: A test checks that every theme has a stylesheet rule in both modes and that the boot script ignores unknown ids (lib/color-themes.test.ts).
Shortcuts are plain data ({ key, mod, shift } steps) passed to one hook, so every feature registers keys the same way (lib/shortcuts.ts:18).
watch: The Shortcuts page lists 'G D: Go to Review Drafts' (settings/shortcuts.tsx:201), but no handler or route for it exists anywhere in the code.
The reference is hand-written apart from the handlers: inbox keys (J, K, E, S, Shift+M) and '/' for list search work but are not listed.
lib/shortcuts.ts (235 lines) has no unit test.
